text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen.
The venue was overflowing with fans eagerly anticipating the BNW showdown.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see it~!
I've been a fan ever since the Japan Derby~!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"That fierce battle was legendary, wasn't it!
I still tear up watching videos of it sometimes."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's already been a year and a half since then, huh...
I can't wait to see how much those three have grown~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, here we go, you two...!
Arima...!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: KINEEEEEEEEEENNNNN!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!?
Whoa, whoa, whoa, why didn't you two say anything!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I wondered what on earth was happening all of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's pep talk time, pep talk time!!
Let's huddle up and get totally fired uuuup!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pass.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~~~~~?! 
B-But today is the Arima Kinen?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but if we do a huddle,
Ticket might get a little too hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even when it comes to the smallest details,
we must eliminate any factors that could hand them a path to victory.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nunununuuuuugh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, I can see you're both dead serious!! But
I have no intention of losing either!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Time to fire myself up all on my own!!
The one who's gonna win is MEEEEEEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, just what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Right back at you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm going all out!!
I call out to her as she shouts all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Traineeer!
You came to see me off~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me, Trainer!!
Today, I am definitely going to win!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'm gonna show you
an amazing dream, okay?!
A smile spread across my face as she made her confident declaration.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Let's get going soon, Ticket.

From beyond the underground tunnel, the anticipation for the fierce battle
about to begin carried over alongside the murmuring crowd.
choice_data_list: (Show them what your race is made of!)
(Show them what your race is made of.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm off and awaaaay!!
The three of them dashed forward together—

And then—an explosive cheer
welcomed BNW.
